## What's new in AniTenshi 1.0.21

- **A new "About" page**: a card at the top shows the version and when it was built, with a gold "Check for updates" button and a link to what's new in this version. Below it, the entries are in named groups like the settings. "Copy device information", to send along when you report a problem, is now an entry you can see; before, it happened only by tapping the version. The links that led nowhere for AniTenshi ("Help translate" and "Issues") are gone.
- **The player's settings, redrawn**: the pages under Settings › Anime player are in three groups (Playback, Audio and subtitles, For experts), with a search bar under the title. Some entries say what they are set to: hardware decoding on or off, and your preferred subtitle and audio languages.
- **Fix**: under "About", in "More" and on the first page of the settings, the version read "AniTenshi AniTenshi 1.0.20". Now the name is written once.
- **A new look for Updates**: the latest episode or chapter you have not watched or read yet is first, in a card of its own with a gold button to watch, read or go on (with how far you got). Then each day is a card with its name in gold and how many are new ("Today · 3 new"). Rows are taller, with a portrait cover, a gold dot on what is new, a thin gold bar on episodes you started, and what you already watched or read dimmed. On tablets the list stays in a column in the middle.
- **A new look for History**: the last title you opened is first, in a "Continue watching" or "Continue reading" card with a gold "Resume" button and how far you got. Each day is a card with its name in gold, as on Updates. Rows have a larger cover, a thin gold bar on episodes left halfway, a gold heart only for titles that are not in your library, and a lighter bin. On tablets the list stays in a column in the middle.
- **A new look for the download queue**: a card at the top says whether downloads are going or paused, and how many titles and episodes or chapters are left, with one gold "Pause" or "Resume" button (it replaces the round button at the bottom; "Resume" also retries the ones that failed). Downloads are grouped by title, each in a card with its cover, source and count; the title's ⋮ moves or cancels all of them. Only the one being downloaded has a gold bar (with the percentage, or the pages for a chapter); the others say "Queued", or "Failed" in red. The count next to each tab is gold on the open one. On tablets the list stays in a column in the middle.
- **Fix**: in the download queue, the number next to the title was always the number of anime, even on the Manga tab. It's gone, as each tab shows its own.
- **A new look for Categories**: all categories are in one card, each with how many titles it has ("12 titles", or "No titles"). A line at the top says that tapping a category renames it and that dragging ≡ changes its order in the library (this was already possible, but hard to guess). Hidden categories are dimmed, with a crossed-out eye and "Hidden". Rename and delete are in the ⋮ menu, so a category isn't deleted by mistake, and the button to add one is gold, "New category". Before deleting, the message says how many titles the category has and that they stay in your library. On tablets the list stays in a column in the middle.
- **A new look for Statistics**: four big numbers at the top (titles in your library, time spent watching or reading, episodes watched or chapters read with a bar of how many of all, completed titles). Then two new cards: a chart of the last 7 days, with how many episodes or chapters you watched or read each day, and "Your library", a bar split into "Caught up" (everything out watched or read), "Started" and "Not started". The other numbers are in rows under them. Times read "3 d 14 h", and numbers are written the way your language writes them. On tablets the four numbers are in one row and the two cards side by side.
- **Fix**: the app could close when a manga from a source was opened twice at once (for example with a quick double tap in Home): it tried to save the same title twice. Titles are now saved one at a time, a second tap in Home is ignored while the title opens, and if opening fails a message says so instead of the app closing. The same also stops an anime from being saved twice.
- **A clearer warning when clearing the history**: the message says what is deleted, that watched episodes and read chapters stay marked, and, in a gold box, that Statistics change too (the "Last 7 days" chart starts again from zero, and for manga the reading time too).
